culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Tetsuo Imai. Sohei Dejima as suspected was poisoned in design office's bathroom. The poison was lathered onto an empty toilet paper roll that the president touched by changing it with a new one. The poison found in his hamburger and hands were merely trace markings. To guarantee the president went to the bathroom when his trap was set, Imai served Dejima's morning coffee with laxatives.

motive.quote: Akemi's short visit, as well as her promise to return with Shiho, would've sooth him of his revenge.

method.quote: Sohei Dejima as suspected was poisoned in design office's bathroom.

evidence.quote: The poison found in his hamburger and hands were merely trace markings.

motive.zhHans: 明美这次短暂的来访，以及她承诺会带着志保一起回来的保证，本该能平息他的复仇之心。
motive.en: Akemi's short visit, as well as her promise to return with Shiho, would've sooth him of his revenge.

method.zhHans: 正如所料，出岛壮平是在设计事务所的洗手间里中毒的。毒被涂在一卷用完的卫生纸筒上，社长在换新纸时碰到了它。在他汉堡和手上验出的毒只是微量痕迹。当有人提出最后使用洗手间的是财津、他也可能中毒时，推断出的理由是：Imai 知道这位同事只会小便，因为几乎听不到冲水声（大楼因据称遭黑衣组织破坏而缺水），而且他注意到财津喝了很多水。装毒用的袋子是从大楼水槽最脏的地方找到的。
method.en: Sohei Dejima as suspected was poisoned in design office's bathroom. The poison was lathered onto an empty toilet paper roll that the president touched by changing it with a new one. The poison found in his hamburger and hands were merely trace markings. When it was brought up that Zaitsu could be poisoned as he used the restroom last, it is reasoned that Imai knew his colleague would only urinate as there was hardly a sound of water being flushed (there was a water shortage in the building due to supposed tampering from the Black Organization) and the fact that he noticed him drinking a lot. The bag used to contain the poison was retrieved from the dirtiest part of the building's sink.

evidence.en: The poison found in his hamburger and hands were merely trace markings.

To guarantee the president went to the bathroom when his trap was set, Imai served Dejima's morning coffee with laxatives. When it was brought up that Zaitsu could be poisoned as he used the restroom last, it is reasoned that Imai knew his colleague would only urinate as there was hardly a sound of water being flushed (there was a water shortage in the building due to supposed tampering from the Black Organization) and the fact that he noticed him drinking a lot.
